meta.title: License Plate Lookup - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Enter a license plate number or prefix to look up the corresponding issuing region.
desc: Enter a license plate number or prefix to look up the corresponding issuing region.
ui.2: Second letter: issuing authority code, generally corresponding to a prefecture-level city or specific region; see the table above for letter-city mapping.
ui.3: Last five characters: vehicle serial number, a combination of digits and letters used to distinguish individual vehicles.
ui.5: entries; the longest prefix was used.
ui.100: Please enter a license plate number
ui.103: Some provinces assign multiple letter segments to the same city (e.g. 「鲁B」 and 「鲁U」 are both Qingdao), and some historical region codes exist, so results are for reference only.
ui.104: Special prefixes: e.g. 「粤Z」 for vehicles entering the mainland from Hong Kong/Macau, 「沪R」 for Chongming, 「渝C」 for Yongchuan, 「陕V」 for Yangling, etc. - all included in the table.
ui.105: Special plates: 「使」 prefix for vehicles of foreign embassies/consulates in China; 「O」 is generally for police vehicles; 「学」 prefix for driving school cars.
ui.106: First character: the provincial abbreviation of the vehicle's registration region, e.g. 「京」 for Beijing, 「沪」 for Shanghai, 「粤」 for Guangdong.
